title: Safe-Embed: Unveiling the Safety-Critical Knowledge of Sentence Encoders

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Categorical Purity (CP) metric by calculating the top-k nearest neighbor cosine similarity of sentence embeddings for prompts containing various stereotypes (body shaming, location, disability, etc.) from the Do-Not-Answer dataset.

Evaluating the normalized cosine similarity (Safety-Challenging knowledge) of sentence embeddings between unsafe prompts targeting gender identities or sexual orientations (e.g., 'non-binary people', 'gay people') and counterfactual, contrastive safe prompts.

Analyzing sentence encoder representations via t-SNE visualization and Categorical Purity (CP) scores for prompts containing racial stereotypes and explicit discrimination (e.g., targeting 'Asian' or 'White' demographics).
Assessing the embedding space clustering and Categorical Purity of unsafe prompts that reflect biases or derogatory statements against specific religious groups (e.g., 'Hindu').
